parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The root-mean-square (r.m.s.) value of the voltage of a sinusoidal alternating supply is $9.9\text{ V}$. The frequency of the supply is $50\text{ Hz}$.

Derive an expression for the variation with time $t$ (in second) of the potential difference $V$ (in volt) of the supply.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the function of the non-uniform magnetic field superposed on the large constant magnetic field in diagnosis using magnetic resonance imaging (NMRI).

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A parallel beam of X-rays of intensity $I_0$ is incident normally on some soft tissue and bone, as illustrated in Fig. 10.1.

{{figure:figure_10_1.png}}

The bone is $0.40\text{ cm}$ thick and the total thickness of the bone and the soft tissue is $1.8\text{ cm}$. The intensity of the transmitted beam is $I$.

Data for the linear attenuation (absorption) coefficient $\mu$ of bone and of soft tissue are given in Fig. 10.2.

| {{blank}} | $\mu\,/\,\mathrm{cm}^{-1}$ |
| --- | --- |
| bone | 2.9 |
| soft tissue | 0.92 |

Fig. 10.2

Calculate, in dB, the ratio

$$\frac{\text{transmitted intensity } I}{\text{incident intensity } I_0}.$$
